Astrologer Partner Terms

Effective 5 October 2026 · Version 2026-10-05

These terms apply when you apply to offer, or offer, consultations on AstroBro as an astrologer ("Partner", "you"). They are in addition to the Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy. By submitting an application you accept them.

1. Our relationship

  • You are an independent professional. You are not an employee, agent or partner of [operator_name not set], and nothing in these terms creates employment.
  • You decide when you are available by going online or offline. You are free to work on other platforms.
  • You are responsible for your own taxes, registrations (for example GST, if it applies to you) and any licences your work needs.

2. Applying and verification

  • You must be 18 or older, live in India, and have a UPI ID or bank account in your own name.
  • Your profile must be truthful: your real name, a real photo of yourself, and honest information about your experience, languages and specialities. Do not claim qualifications, titles or awards you do not have.
  • We review every application and may approve or reject it. Before approval or before paying you, we may ask for proof of identity and your PAN for verification and tax purposes.
  • We may edit the format of your profile and remove anything that breaks these terms.

3. Rates and platform fee

  • You set your per-minute rates for chat, voice and video within the limits shown in the app. A new rate applies only to sessions that start after the change.
  • AstroBro collects the payment from the user. For each consultation we keep a platform fee of 30% of the amount charged, which covers payment processing, hosting and support. The remaining 70% is your earnings.
  • We will give you at least 30 days' notice before we change the platform fee.

4. Payouts

  • Your earnings appear in your dashboard as they are earned.
  • We pay your earnings to the UPI ID registered on your profile at least once a month. Make sure the UPI ID is correct and in your name; we are not responsible for payments sent to a UPI ID you gave us by mistake.
  • Where the law requires, we deduct tax at source from your payouts and give you the details.
  • If a user is refunded because you broke these terms, or a payment is reversed, we may deduct that amount from your unpaid earnings.
  • Earnings from a session that is under investigation may be held until the investigation ends, for up to 90 days.

5. How you must work

You must:

  • be respectful, honest and patient with every user;
  • respond promptly once you accept a request, and end the session when the user asks;
  • keep everything the user shares confidential;
  • make clear that your guidance is an interpretation, not a certainty;
  • if a user says they are thinking about harming themselves or is in danger, stop the reading, give them the Tele-MANAS number 14416 and the emergency number 112, encourage them to get help, and report it to us. Never use their distress to sell anything;
  • end the session and report it if you believe the user is under 18.

You must not:

  • promise or guarantee results, or claim to know the future for certain;
  • claim that any remedy cures or prevents a disease, recommend medicines, or tell anyone to stop or delay medical treatment;
  • give legal advice, or investment, trading, stock, cryptocurrency, lottery or betting tips (only SEBI-registered advisers may give investment advice);
  • offer or perform "black magic", vashikaran, curse removal for money, exorcism, animal sacrifice, or any practice banned by law, including under the Maharashtra Prevention and Eradication of Human Sacrifice and other Inhuman, Evil and Aghori Practices and Black Magic Act, 2013 and the Karnataka Prevention and Eradication of Inhuman Evil Practices and Black Magic Act, 2017;
  • frighten users (for example with talk of death, curses or harm to their family) to pressure them into buying remedies, pujas or products;
  • sell or recommend products or services from outside AstroBro, or accept any payment, gift or tip outside AstroBro;
  • share or ask for phone numbers, email addresses, social media handles, links or addresses, or arrange to meet users;
  • record, screenshot or share a consultation without the user's clear consent;
  • harass, insult or discriminate against anyone on the basis of gender, caste, religion, region or any other ground, or send sexual content;
  • pass off AI-generated text as your own personal reading;
  • post or request fake reviews, offer rewards for reviews, or retaliate against users who leave a poor review.

6. Users' personal data

  • Use the information users share only for the consultation they asked for.
  • Do not copy, store or share it outside AstroBro. Delete any notes you made once they are no longer needed.
  • Tell us immediately at [grievance_email not set] if you think a user's data has been exposed.
  • You must follow the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 when handling users' data.

7. Your profile and content

You allow us to show your name, photo, profile and ratings in the app and to use them to promote the AstroBro astrologer service. You can ask us at any time to stop using them for promotion. We store your consultation messages as described in the Privacy Policy.

8. Suspension and ending

  • We may suspend or remove your profile if you break these terms, receive repeated well-founded complaints, provide false information, or put users at risk. Serious breaches (such as fraud, threats or unlawful practices) lead to immediate removal and may be reported to the authorities.
  • You can stop at any time by going offline and asking us to remove your profile.
  • When our relationship ends, we pay you all earnings that are not under dispute.

9. Responsibility

You are responsible for the advice you give. If a claim is made against AstroBro because of your conduct or because you broke these terms or the law, you agree to cover the reasonable costs and losses that result.

10. Changes and disputes

  • We will give you at least 15 days' notice of important changes to these terms, by email or in the app.
  • These terms are governed by the laws of India, and the courts at [jurisdiction_city not set], India have jurisdiction.
  • Questions or complaints: [grievance_email not set].
